who.en:
For every household, and especially one with young children or older people. Injuries at home are common and mostly minor (cuts, grazes, burns from cooking and hot drinks, sprains, insect bites), but the first minutes decide how they heal. A child with diarrhoea, still the third leading cause of death in children aged 1–59 months (WHO), needs rehydration to start at home.

The kit is built on what WHO says to do first. Burns: cool with running water for about 20 minutes, remove rings and clothing not stuck to the wound, cover with a clean non-adherent dressing or cloth, and never apply ice, oil, butter, toothpaste or traditional pastes (WHO burns fact sheet). The kit therefore carries non-stick pads and no burn gel. Diarrhoea: ORS and a 10–14 day course of zinc (WHO), supplied by the partner pharmacy. Poisoning: medicines are stored in one closed box out of children’s reach (WHO World report on child injury prevention). Wounds: clean, cover and check tetanus protection after any dirty or deep wound (WHO tetanus fact sheet). Red Cross and IFRC first-aid guidance could not be consulted for this box, so it is not cited.

The household buys the complete kit once. Refills come every three months to replace what was used and anything near expiry; they ride in another Afya box the household already receives, or are collected at the free three-monthly kit check in store.
who.sw:
Kwa kila kaya, hasa yenye watoto wadogo au wazee. Majeraha nyumbani ni ya kawaida na mengi ni madogo (vidonda, michubuko, kuungua wakati wa kupika au kwa vinywaji vya moto, kuteguka, kuumwa na wadudu), lakini dakika za kwanza huamua yanavyopona. Mtoto anayeharisha, ambalo bado ni chanzo cha tatu cha vifo vya watoto wenye miezi 1–59 (WHO), anahitaji kuanza kurejeshewa maji akiwa nyumbani.

Sanduku limejengwa juu ya hatua za kwanza zinazoshauriwa na WHO. Kuungua: poza kwa maji ya bomba kwa takriban dakika 20, ondoa pete na nguo zisizoshikamana na jeraha, funika kwa bandeji safi isiyonata au kitambaa safi, na kamwe usipake barafu, mafuta, siagi, dawa ya meno wala dawa za kienyeji (taarifa ya WHO kuhusu kuungua). Kwa hiyo sanduku lina pedi zisizonata na halina jeli ya kuungua. Kuharisha: ORS na zinki kwa siku 10–14 (WHO), zinazotolewa na famasia mshirika. Sumu: dawa huhifadhiwa ndani ya sanduku moja lililofungwa, mbali na watoto (ripoti ya WHO kuhusu kuzuia majeraha kwa watoto). Majeraha: safisha, funika na hakikisha kinga ya pepopunda baada ya jeraha lolote chafu au lenye kina (taarifa ya WHO kuhusu pepopunda). Miongozo ya huduma ya kwanza ya Msalaba Mwekundu na IFRC haikuweza kupatikana kwa sanduku hili, hivyo haijatajwa.

Kaya hununua sanduku kamili mara moja. Vitu vya kujaza huja kila miezi mitatu kuchukua nafasi ya vilivyotumika na vinavyokaribia kuisha muda; huja ndani ya sanduku lingine la Afya ambalo kaya tayari inapokea, au huchukuliwa dukani wakati wa ukaguzi wa bure wa sanduku kila miezi mitatu.

clinic_line.en: This kit is for minor injuries and for the first minutes before help arrives. Any medicine, and its dose for a child, is set by the pharmacist or your clinic. Go to a clinic or call for help straight away for a burn larger than the person’s palm or on the face, hands, feet or genitals, an electrical or chemical burn, bleeding that does not stop with firm pressure, a deep or dirty wound, a suspected broken bone, a head injury, a snake bite, a fever in a baby under three months, or a child with diarrhoea who cannot drink or is very sleepy.
clinic_line.sw: Sanduku hili ni kwa majeraha madogo na kwa dakika za kwanza kabla msaada haujafika. Dawa yoyote, na dozi yake kwa mtoto, huwekwa na mfamasia au kliniki yako. Nenda kliniki au omba msaada mara moja kwa kuungua kukubwa kuliko kiganja cha mtu au usoni, mikononi, miguuni au sehemu za siri, kuungua kwa umeme au kemikali, damu isiyokoma kwa kubana kwa nguvu, jeraha lenye kina au chafu, mfupa unaodhaniwa kuvunjika, jeraha la kichwa, kuumwa na nyoka, homa kwa mtoto chini ya miezi mitatu, au mtoto anayeharisha asiyeweza kunywa au mwenye usingizi mzito.

name.en: Oral rehydration salts (ORS), for diarrhoea (partner pharmacy)
name.sw: Chumvi ya kurejesha maji mwilini (ORS), kwa kuharisha (famasia mshirika)

why.en: WHO: diarrhoeal disease is the third leading cause of death in children aged 1–59 months, and it is treated with ORS. Having sachets at home means rehydration starts at the first loose stool, on the way to the clinic. Supplied by the licensed partner pharmacy; Afya does not sell or price it. Public clinics give ORS free for children under five.
why.sw: WHO: magonjwa ya kuharisha ni chanzo cha tatu cha vifo vya watoto wenye umri wa miezi 1–59, na hutibiwa kwa ORS. Kuwa na pakiti nyumbani kunamaanisha kurejesha maji huanza katika choo cha kwanza cha majimaji, njiani kwenda kliniki. Hutolewa na famasia mshirika yenye leseni; Afya haiuzi wala haiweki bei yake. Kliniki za umma hutoa ORS bure kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano.

items.qty_formula: 1 episode of diarrhoea in a child: about 4 sachets over 1–2 days (the pharmacist advises the volume). Not priced (B4).

name.en: Zinc tablets, for a child’s diarrhoea (partner pharmacy)
name.sw: Vidonge vya zinki, kwa mtoto anayeharisha (famasia mshirika)

why.en: WHO: a 10–14 day course of dispersible zinc shortens diarrhoea and cuts stool volume by about 30%. The dose depends on the child’s age and is set by the pharmacist or clinic; supplied by the partner pharmacy, not priced in the box.
why.sw: WHO: dozi ya zinki ya siku 10–14 hufupisha muda wa kuharisha na hupunguza kiasi cha choo kwa takriban 30%. Dozi hutegemea umri wa mtoto na huwekwa na mfamasia au kliniki; hutolewa na famasia mshirika, bei yake haimo kwenye sanduku.

items.qty_formula: 1 tablet a day × 10 days, the shortest WHO course (the pharmacist sets the dose). Not priced (B4).

why.en: For pain and fever in adults, at the dose on the pack or as the pharmacist advises. Supplied by the licensed partner pharmacy, not priced in the box. A fever in Tanzania can be malaria: it is tested at the clinic, not just treated at home.
why.sw: Kwa maumivu na homa kwa watu wazima, kwa dozi iliyoandikwa kwenye pakiti au kama mfamasia anavyoshauri. Hutolewa na famasia mshirika yenye leseni, bei yake haimo kwenye sanduku. Homa nchini Tanzania inaweza kuwa malaria: hupimwa kliniki, si kutibiwa nyumbani tu.

name.sw: Kifuko cha baridi cha papo hapo

why.en: Few homes have ice at hand. A squeeze cold pack, wrapped in a cloth and held on a bruise or sprain for short periods, eases pain and swelling. It is never used on a burn: burns are cooled with running water (WHO).
why.sw: Nyumba chache huwa na barafu tayari. Kifuko cha baridi kinachobanwa, kikifungwa kwa kitambaa na kuwekwa kwenye uvimbe au sehemu iliyoteguka kwa muda mfupi, hupunguza maumivu na uvimbe. Hakitumiki kamwe kwenye kuungua: sehemu iliyoungua hupozwa kwa maji ya bomba (WHO).

name.en: Antiseptic for the skin around a wound
name.sw: Dawa ya kusafisha ngozi kuzunguka jeraha

why.en: Wounds are cleaned first with clean running water. A mild antiseptic is used on the skin around a dirty graze or bite. Any deep or dirty wound also needs a tetanus check at the clinic (WHO: tetanus enters through cuts and wounds).
why.sw: Majeraha husafishwa kwanza kwa maji safi ya bomba. Dawa laini ya kusafisha hutumika kwenye ngozi inayozunguka mchubuko mchafu au jeraha la kuumwa. Jeraha lolote lenye kina au chafu linahitaji pia kukaguliwa chanjo ya pepopunda kliniki (WHO: pepopunda huingia kupitia vidonda na majeraha).

name.en: Oral rehydration salts (ORS), for diarrhoea (partner pharmacy)
name.sw: Chumvi ya kurejesha maji mwilini (ORS), kwa kuharisha (famasia mshirika)

why.en: WHO: diarrhoeal disease is the third leading cause of death in children aged 1–59 months, and it is treated with ORS. Having sachets at home means rehydration starts at the first loose stool, on the way to the clinic. Supplied by the licensed partner pharmacy; Afya does not sell or price it. Public clinics give ORS free for children under five.
why.sw: WHO: magonjwa ya kuharisha ni chanzo cha tatu cha vifo vya watoto wenye umri wa miezi 1–59, na hutibiwa kwa ORS. Kuwa na pakiti nyumbani kunamaanisha kurejesha maji huanza katika choo cha kwanza cha majimaji, njiani kwenda kliniki. Hutolewa na famasia mshirika yenye leseni; Afya haiuzi wala haiweki bei yake. Kliniki za umma hutoa ORS bure kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano.

items.qty_formula: to keep at least 4 at home. Not priced (B4).

brands.product: ORS with zinc and probiotic sachets

name.sw: Paracetamol miligramu 500 kwa watu wazima (famasia mshirika)

why.en: For pain and fever in adults, at the dose on the pack or as the pharmacist advises. Supplied by the licensed partner pharmacy, not priced in the box. A fever in Tanzania can be malaria: it is tested at the clinic, not just treated at home.
why.sw: Kwa maumivu na homa kwa watu wazima, kwa dozi iliyoandikwa kwenye pakiti au kama mfamasia anavyoshauri. Hutolewa na famasia mshirika yenye leseni, bei yake haimo kwenye sanduku. Homa nchini Tanzania inaweza kuwa malaria: hupimwa kliniki, si kutibiwa nyumbani tu.

name.en: Metal wall cabinet for the kit, mounted out of children’s reach
name.sw: Kabati la chuma la ukutani kwa sanduku, linalowekwa mbali na watoto

luxury.product: Medium metal wall cabinet for first aid (empty)

tiers.en: Regular = the complete kit with default brands. Premium = kit + a second ready-filled kit for the car or handbag. Luxury = kit + a metal wall cabinet. The luxury item is bought once, priced as its own line at shelf price, outside the saving (D4).
tiers.sw: Kawaida = sanduku kamili lenye chapa za msingi. Premium = sanduku + sanduku la pili lililojazwa tayari kwa gari au mkoba. Anasa = sanduku + kabati la chuma la ukutani. Bidhaa ya anasa hununuliwa mara moja, ina bei yake peke yake kwa bei ya rafu, nje ya punguzo (D4).

services_note.en: Included at no fee (store services): a kit check every 3 months with free replacement of expired items, and a thermometer and kit demonstration at the first visit. Public services, fee 0: tetanus vaccination after a dirty or deep wound, and ORS and zinc for children under five at public clinics. Add-on with no partner quote yet (R7): a first-aid course with an accredited trainer.
services_note.sw: Zimo bila ada (huduma za duka): ukaguzi wa sanduku kila miezi 3 na kubadilisha bure vitu vilivyoisha muda, na maonyesho ya kipimajoto na sanduku katika ziara ya kwanza. Huduma za umma, ada 0: chanjo ya pepopunda baada ya jeraha chafu au lenye kina, na ORS na zinki kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano katika kliniki za umma. Huduma ya nyongeza ambayo bado haina bei ya mshirika (R7): mafunzo ya huduma ya kwanza kwa mkufunzi aliyeidhinishwa.

delivery_note.en: The complete kit is delivered once. Refills come every 3 months and are not delivered on their own: they ride in another Afya box the household receives, or are collected at the free in-store kit check, because a refill this small cannot pay for its own packing and delivery (D4 check).
delivery_note.sw: Sanduku kamili huletwa mara moja. Vitu vya kujaza huja kila miezi 3 na haviletwi peke yake: huja ndani ya sanduku lingine la Afya ambalo kaya hupokea, au huchukuliwa dukani wakati wa ukaguzi wa bure wa sanduku, kwa sababu kujaza kudogo hivi hakuwezi kulipia upakiaji na usafirishaji wake (kipimo cha D4).

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (S 3,500 · M 5,000 · L 6,500) and delivery 3,500 included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares 78% brand / 72% pharm / 50% own) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0.
pricing_rule.note: The complete kit is priced per kit; the refill per 3-monthly refill. Medicines and the luxury line are outside the shelf value. Market reference (not a model): AfyaDepot sells a ready-filled “Smart First Aid” kit, home size, at TSh 45,000 (contents not itemised on the page).

open.en: Plasters, gauze, roller and crepe bandages, scissors, tweezers, gloves and the triangular bandage have Kenyan prices only (KES × 20.33, not re-opened); AfyaDepot and Shoppers list none of them. Tanzanian distributor prices are needed.
open.sw: Plasta, shashi, bandeji za kuzungusha na za kunyumbulika, mkasi, koleo, glavu na bandeji ya pembetatu vina bei za Kenya tu (KES × 20.33, hazikufunguliwa tena); AfyaDepot na Shoppers hazina hata kimoja. Bei za wasambazaji wa Tanzania zinahitajika.

open.en: Red Cross and IFRC first-aid guidance could not be opened; the card and the sprain and bite items should be checked against the Tanzania Red Cross Society’s guidance before print.
open.sw: Miongozo ya huduma ya kwanza ya Msalaba Mwekundu na IFRC haikuweza kufunguliwa; kadi na vitu vya kuteguka na kuumwa na wadudu vikaguliwe dhidi ya miongozo ya Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania kabla ya kuchapishwa.

open.en: The first-aid card is an estimate (TSh 2,000) until a print quote is obtained.
open.sw: Bei ya kadi ya huduma ya kwanza ni makadirio (TSh 2,000) hadi bei ya uchapishaji ipatikane.

open.en: Refill quantities are planning assumptions; the in-store kit check should record what each household actually used.
open.sw: Idadi ya vitu vya kujaza ni makadirio ya mpango; ukaguzi wa sanduku dukani urekodi kila kaya ilichotumia kweli.
